# Sebastian Private Accountant

Sebastian is a private accountant in Atwater Village, Los Angeles, at 3108 Perlita Avenue, holding a city business license from 1977.
We prepare personal and business tax returns, federal and California, along with the 1099s and W-2s that go with them.
We keep monthly books, reconcile accounts, and produce financial statements.
We handle business management and payroll, including entity setup and transaction processing.
We file information reporting: estimated taxes, quarterly sales tax, and company filings.
We work with writers, artists, and people in entertainment, and with households and small businesses that want a private accountant rather than a mill.
Starting rates for an IRS Form 1040 and a California Form 540 begin at $65 plus a $25 processing fee, with a half-hour interview included.
Meetings are in person, by appointment.
Hours: Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., and Saturday 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. during tax season.
Phone: (323) 668-7777.
Email: sebtax@earthlink.net.
Website: http://www.sebtaxla.com/
